title: Calendar export retention policy
synopsis: Calendar exports keep 30 days of event history.
content: When implementing the calendar export, retain exactly 30 days of event history. Redact attendee email addresses before writing the export.

title: Deprecated calendar export retention
synopsis: Older planning note for calendar exports.
content: An abandoned draft suggested keeping 7 days of calendar event history. The calendar export policy uses a different retention window.

title: Invoice reconciliation rounding rule
synopsis: Invoice totals sum cents before formatting.
content: For invoice reconciliation, sum line-item cents first, then format the final total to two decimal places. Do not round each line independently.

title: Deprecated invoice rounding note
synopsis: Older rounding approach that produces mismatched totals.
content: A rejected draft rounded each line item before summing. That approach creates reconciliation drift and must not be used.
